tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Internet availability and fiber context for a US address or area. Give one geography shape: a street address (for example '520 South Main Street, Goshen, Indiana 46526'), lat+lng, FCC location_id, 5-digit ZIP, city+state (for example Warsaw, IN), state, or a city alone for disambiguation candidates.

tools.name: provider_profile
tools.description: Canonical profile of a US internet provider by name (handles brand variants, e.g. 'ATT', 'Google Fiber'). Returns the canonical identity, FCC registration numbers, technologies filed, the live profile URL, and — when precomputed — an answer pack of grounded sections (overview, coverage, measured-vs-

tools.name: area_intelligence
tools.description: Coverage intelligence for a US city: how many providers file service, fiber availability share, and the dominant technologies — honest numbers with their grain and vintage stated. Give city and two-letter state.

tools.name: location_intelligence
tools.description: Res-8 hex intelligence (~0.46 km cells) for any US coordinate: how many FCC locations, providers by technology, fiber density, competition and underserved status, and best available speeds in that immediate neighborhood. Give lat+lng (for example Goshen, IN: 41.5820, -85.8344), or an H3 res-8 hex_id

tools.name: industry_overview
tools.description: US telecom market at national scale: total providers, total FCC-registered locations, technology mix (how many locations have fiber vs cable vs other filed), and the filing vintages held. findings.detail: Tool "check_availability" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
